title: The Golden Heart
description: An educational video explaining the concept of the Golden Heart, its historical origins, symbolic meanings, and modern applications in psychology and culture.
thumbnailPrompt: A serene golden heart floating above a calm blue background with soft light rays

audio.text: Welcome to our exploration of the Golden Heart, a symbol rich in history and meaning.

scenes.title: Historical Roots
scenes.subtitle: From Ancient Artifacts to Modern Icons

items.text: From Ancient Artifacts to Modern Icons

audio.text: The Golden Heart first appeared in ancient artifacts, symbolizing divine love and protection. Over centuries, it evolved into a cultural icon across religions and societies.

scenes.title: Golden Heart Symbol
scenes.imagePrompt: A detailed illustration of a golden heart surrounded by subtle floral patterns on a light blue background

audio.text: Notice the intricate design, which often incorporates elements of nature and geometry to emphasize harmony.

scenes.title: Psychological Significance
scenes.subtitle: Heart as a Metaphor for Empathy

elements.title: Psychological Significance
elements.definition: Heart as a Metaphor for Empathy

audio.text: In psychology, the golden heart symbolizes empathy and altruism. It reminds us to nurture compassion within ourselves and others.

scenes.title: Modern Applications
scenes.imagePrompt: A collage of modern logos and icons featuring golden hearts in healthcare, education, and community outreach programs on a white backdrop

audio.text: Today, the golden heart appears in branding for charities, health initiatives, and educational tools, reinforcing its message of care.
The Golden Heart transcends time, reminding us that empathy and love are universal values. Thank you for watching.
